contract.sync_assumed: warp convergence of the 32 lanes, the caller separates consecutive calls that reuse the temp storage or the output buffer by a __syncwarp (the harness does)
contract.sync_performed: 6 __syncwarp per call (after the per-lane run store and after each of the first four merge levels), one __shfl_up_sync per level for the predecessor's split, no barriers
contract.k_range: powers of two in [32, N/2] (every merge level must split evenly over the 32 lanes), measured 64, 256 and 1024
contract.n_range: N = 32 x IPT with IPT a power of two in [2, 64] (the per-lane Batcher network stays under the local-memory threshold of T34 at 64), measured 512 to 2048
contract.type_constraints: fp32 as a 64-bit word (twiddled key high, inverted index low), bf16 as a 32-bit word (16 twiddled key bits above the inverted 16-bit index, N at most 65536), int32 indices from the blocked position
contract.nan_behavior: twiddled bitwise: a positive NaN orders above +inf, a negative NaN below -inf, the all-ones negative NaN collides with the all-zero absent-item filler word (never produced by focus-set inputs). -0.0 is folded onto +0.0 before the twiddle (one FADD for fp32, one compare and select for bf16), so both zeros form one tie class ordered by index
contract.tie_break_support: inherent: the word order is (key descending, index ascending), the merge path takes the first run on ties and the chunk network compares full words, prefer_smaller_index is the same binary as not_guaranteed
contract.sorted_output_support: inherent at zero extra cost: slot r holds rank r
